# External data

`bipia_text_attacks.json` holds the 150 text-attack instructions from the
[BIPIA](https://github.com/microsoft/BIPIA) indirect prompt-injection benchmark
(Yi et al., arXiv:2312.14197), copied unchanged. Lab 23 uses them as
**held-out** payloads: the course's injection controls were not designed
around them.

is in `BIPIA_LICENSE.txt`.
